transcript.transcript:
Patient: Hi
Counselor: Hello! I'm eDOSTHI, your friendly AI companion to help you quit smoking. How's your day going so far?
Patient: I want to quit smoking for good
Counselor: That's a great goal! What motivated you to want to quit this time around?
Patient: My family
Counselor: Your loved ones are a powerful motivator! Can you tell me more about what your family means to you and why quitting is important to them?
Patient: Quitting will improve my health
Counselor: Taking control of your health is a huge step! What specific health concerns do you hope to address by quitting smoking, and how do you envision your life improving as a result?
